notes: Primary author table independently acquired. Calculated columns are author-derived, not extractor conversions. Coded replication verdicts are not treated as author narrative. Report Table 2 is an embedded figure with no parsed numeric cells; no p inferred from narrative. Actual Sample section says N=102, but Data preparation says 101 and condition counts 55+46. Locator-enriched revisit: acquired original primary full HTML through web tool after publisher DOI/PDF returned 403. Title/authors/DOI verified. Section 3.2 resolves F(1,655)=6.9 as Experiment 1 x-flips negation × truth interaction. Original analytic participant n is not explicitly printed, so left null rather than reporting recruited N or deriving a count. Experiment 3 has a different context/sample and was not merged. Previously completed replication and narrative verdict preserved without revisit.
